### 🟡 Changes recommended Separator insertion also affects `content="all"`, adding an unintended chunk to rich-content streams; both sync and async paths need text-only gating and regression tests.
1 open issue - [Avoid inserting text separators for content="all" responses](https://github.com/posit-dev/chatlas/pull/482#discussion_r4519561740) · New
What changed in this PR This PR aligns synchronous and asynchronous text output around tool calls, separating successive text rounds without adding leading blank lines to tool-first responses. **Changes:** - Introduces a shared `_TextSeparator` for both chat loops. - Adds fake-provider regression tests for streaming and chat responses. - Documents the formatting correction in the changelog. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `tests/​test_stream_tool_separator.py` | Tests sync and async text separation and tool-first responses. | | `chatlas/​_chat.py` | Adds shared separator state and replaces unconditional async separators. | | `CHANGELOG.md` | Describes the text-formatting correction. |
Review effort: Balanced

### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are recorded for the changes aligning synchronous and asynchronous text output around tool calls. **No open issues** 🎉

review_comments.body: Text chunks remain plain strings with `content="all"`, so a text → tool → text response now gains an extra `"\n\n"` chunk, changing the rich-content stream that should remain unchanged. Gate separator insertion on `content == "text"` here and in the async loop at `chatlas/_chat.py:2888`. Add sync and async regression cases for `content="all"`.
